description: Dedicated question bank for the You Get Me prediction game. The answerer chooses one of four options; their partner predicts that choice.

questions.question: If aliens abducted us and let me choose one thing to bring aboard, what would I grab?
If I woke up with a superpower that only worked on Tuesdays, which would I hope for?
If I had to compete in the Intergalactic Olympics, what event would I somehow enter?

options: Replace all alarms with kazoo music
Make every elevator play my theme song
Hide the world’s last good snack
